subject: gk
question: The Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha is removed from his office by:

options.text: the order of the Vice-President of India
the order of the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India
a resolution of the Lok Sabha passed by a majority of all the then members of the Lok Sabha
the order of the Attorney-General for India

solution:
The correct answer is __**a resolution of the Lok Sabha passed by a majority of all the then members of the Lok Sabha**__**.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• Parliament consists of** Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha and President**.
 
• Lok Sabha has a **preceding officer called the Speaker** who controls the proceeding of the house.
